# TinyMCE

> TinyMCE is the world's most trusted WYSIWYG rich text editor, powering content editing for 1.5M+ developers across web applications, CMS platforms, LMS systems, and enterprise solutions.

TinyMCE offers both self-hosted and cloud-hosted versions with premium plugins for collaboration, AI assistance, accessibility, and advanced content management. The platform provides extensive documentation, framework integrations for React/Vue/Angular, and commercial licensing options alongside open-source availability.

## Key Topics

- WYSIWYG Editor
- Rich Text Editor
- TinyMCE 8
